title: Solos e Rochas Contaminados
excerpt: BUILT CoLAB has established a protocol with APA and the Environmental Fund with the aim of promoting a series of actions within the scope of the “Avaliação da Qualidade do Solo” project.
content:
BUILT CoLAB has established a protocol with APA and the Environmental Fund with the aim of promoting a series of actions within the scope of the “Avaliação da Qualidade do Solo” project.

The main focus of these actions is Contaminated Soils and Rocks, with the aim of sensitising various players to the processes of assessing soil quality and its risk analysis and sustainable remediation, thus contributing to preventing and combating soil pollution.

Main Actions

  • Three training sessions were organised for three different target audiences: designers, building owners and regulators, construction and demolition companies, soil remediation organisations.
  • Development and dissemination of documentation and technical support media on the assessment and remediation of contaminated soils.

Complete information at https://builtcolab.pt/solos-rochas-contaminados/ .
